title: The Rutting Elk
text: Two great elk lock antlers in the clearing, bellowing, steam pouring from their nostrils, hooves tearing the earth. They are too lost in their fight to notice you. One is bleeding badly from the neck. Shed antlers lie in the churned mud between them.

options.label: Wait for them to finish; no one steps between two bulls.

outcomes.text: The loser limps away. The winner bellows at you before it goes, and its challenge stays in your blood.

options.label: The quickest snatches a shed antler from between them while they fight.

outcomes.text: It is a fine antler, taken without harm.
An elk turns on them, antlers first.

options.label: The Leader brings one down while they are busy with each other.

outcomes.text: You have meat for the road, but the other elk charges.
